subject: Aligning termination-for-convenience triggers and renewal cadence for Nimbus pilot
messages:
From: Elaine Humphreys <elaine.humphreys@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure <procure@nimbuscloud.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Termination & auto-renew questions — Nimbus pilot MSA/Order Form
Attachments: Nimbus_MSA_redline_v2.docx

Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the internal team at Nimbus asked us to kick off a quick alignment on a couple of contract items before we proceed to signature. I attached our redline (Nimbus_MSA_redline_v2.docx) with inline comments but called out the main asks below so we can confirm positions quickly: 

1) Auto-renew: We prefer a single 12-month renewal with a 60-day written notice to opt-out. Can Redwood support a 60-day notice?
2) Termination for convenience: Nimbus would like a mutual termination-for-convenience right with a 30-day service wind-down (data handover & export assistance). We also requested a limited termination fee only if termination occurs within the first 90 days.
3) Notice windows: If mutual termination exists, we want the ability to stagger service wind-down to keep production environments stable (example timelines in the doc).
4) SOW/Order Form: We expect a 30-day transition for any active pilots to hand over logs and KV cache snapshot for continuity.

Can you please confirm Redwood's position on 1–3 and share any proposed language? If possible, we'd like a short call with your legal team on Tuesday (Aug 11) to resolve open items ahead of procurement review.

Appreciate it,
Elaine

--
Elaine Humphreys
Head of Procurement, Nimbus Cloud
elaine.humphreys@nimbuscloud.com
+1 415-555-0142

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Humphreys <elaine.humphreys@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Termination & auto-renew questions — Nimbus pilot MSA/Order Form
Attachments: Redwood_termination_options.pdf

Elaine — thanks for the clear summary and the redlines. Looping in Laura (legal) and Marissa (CS lead) to weigh in on the language and operational impacts. Quick summary of Redwood's current thinking so we can focus the call: 

- Auto-renew: We typically offer 12-month renewal terms with a 30- to 60-day notice window depending on the customer tier. For pilot customers we'd accept 60 days if Nimbus needs it, but we prefer the window be aligned to billing cycles to avoid proration complexity.
- Termination for convenience: We can agree to mutual termination-for-convenience. Recommended guardrails: (a) a 30-day wind-down for production transition, (b) a carve-out that any outstanding invoiced usage is payable on termination, and (c) limit early-termination fees to defined circumstances (e.g., committed capacity buy-down).
- Data handover: We can commit to providing export assistance and KV cache snapshot within the 30-day wind-down for an agreed transfer fee if there's heavy engineering involvement.

Proposed next steps: Laura, can you draft two short redline options (Option A: 60-day auto-renew/30-day TFC; Option B: 30-day auto-renew/30-day TFC with a narrow early-termination fee) so Elaine's team can pick? Elaine — would 30 minutes on Tue Aug 11, 10:00–10:30 PT work for a review with legal?

If that works I'll prepare a one-page matrix and upload the suggested language to DocuSign.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Elaine Humphreys <elaine.humphreys@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Termination & auto-renew questions — Nimbus pilot MSA/Order Form
Attachments: Redwood_suggested_redlines.docx

Elaine / Karthik,

Thanks for the context. I reviewed Nimbus' redline and put together two drafting approaches in the attached document (Redwood_suggested_redlines.docx). Below are the salient legal points and our recommended compromise language you can paste into the MSA/Order Form: 

1) Auto-Renew:
Option A (customer-favored): "This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive 12-month terms unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term."
Option B (balanced): "... unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days prior to the end of the then-current term."
Recommendation: Option A is acceptable for Nimbus as a pilot if Nimbus confirms billing/proration logic in the Order Form; otherwise Option B reduces operational lift.

2) Termination for Convenience (mutual):
Draft language: "Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to the other party provided that (a) the terminating party pays any unpaid usage fees through the effective date, and (b) the parties shall cooperate in a reasonable wind-down to preserve customer data and to facilitate an orderly transition of services. Any termination fee shall be limited to charges for unused prepaid dedicated capacity and shall not exceed the prepaid amount remaining for the then-current term."
Notes: This limits Redwood exposure while offering Nimbus a mutual right; it also narrows termination fees to prepaid committed capacity so Nimbus is not exposed to open-ended penalties.

3) Data Handover / Transition:
We can commit to export assistance and a KV cache snapshot within the 30-day wind-down window. If engineering assistance beyond standard export tooling is required, we propose a one-time engineering service fee to cover manual export/transfer work; the amount should be defined in the SOW or a statement of work annex.

4) Practical:
- If Nimbus insists on a 60-day auto-renew notice, we need to add a line in the Order Form clarifying proration and billing cycles.
- All redlines will be uploaded to the DocuSign envelope for quick sign-off after your internal approval.

Next steps: Karthik — I'll finalize Option A/B redlines in the attached doc and upload to the HubSpot deal and DocuSign envelope. Elaine — please confirm if Tue 10:00 PT works or suggest an alternate time.

Regards,
Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Thanks all — grateful for the quick turnaround. Elaine, Tue 10:00 PT is confirmed for the short legal sync (I've booked 10–10:30 PT and sent a calendar invite). Laura — appreciate the two-option approach; please upload the redline doc to DocuSign and HubSpot (deal: DEAL-78921) by EOD today so Nimbus can review before the call.

Action items and owners: 
- Laura: upload Redwood_suggested_redlines.docx to DocuSign + add the Option A/B language to the MSA; include a short note about proration if Nimbus picks 60-day auto-renew. (owner: laura.bennett@redwood.ai)

We'll aim to have a clean Order Form and MSA language ready for signature by the end of next week pending Nimbus' selection.

Best,
Karthik
